articles.title: Delhi To Launch Smart Ration Card System: QR Codes, Face Verification And Online Services
articles.description: The Delhi government is preparing to roll out the Smart Public Distribution System (Smart-PDS), a major digital overhaul of ration distribution across the national capital. Under the new system, existing ration cards will be upgraded with QR codes, while beneficiaries will be able to access services such as adding or removing family members, uploading documents, tracking applications and monitoring ration deliveries online.The Smart-PDS will also introduce facial recognition as an alternative to fingerprint authentication, helping beneficiaries who face biometric verification issues. The government says the combination of QR codes, digital records and facial verification will help eliminate fake ration cards, duplicate entries, black marketing and the diversion of subsidised foodgrains.
